chunks: Ali b. Ahmad b. Abdullah b. Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah al-Barqi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us, from his grandfather Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah, from Muhammad b. Ali al-Kufi, from Abu Abdillah al-Khayyat, from Abdullah b. al-Qasim, from Abdullah b. Sinan, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him).

He said: Among that which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to Musa b. Imran (peace be upon him): O Musa! Be like a worn-out robe, pure of heart, reclusive in your house, and a lantern in the night. You will be known among the people of heaven and hidden from the people of earth.
O Musa! Beware of stubbornness, and do not be among those who walk without purpose, and do not laugh without astonishment, and weep over your sin, O son of Imran.

key_terms.اللجاجة: Stubbornness/insistence -- obstinate persistence in argument or wrong
key_terms.حلس البيت: Recluse of the house -- one who remains devoted to worship in seclusion
key_terms.خلق الثوب: Worn-out robe -- metaphor for humility and disinterest in worldly appearances
key_terms.مصباح الليل: Lantern of the night -- one who illuminates the darkness through night worship

ai.seo_question: What did Allah reveal to Prophet Musa about humility, purity of heart, and avoiding stubbornness?
ai.summary: This hadith relays a divine exhortation from Allah to Prophet Musa ibn Imran (Moses), transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq (AS). God instructs Musa to adopt humility in appearance, purity of heart, seclusion in worship, and vigilance at night -- qualities that elevate one in heaven while keeping one unassuming on earth. The concluding warnings against stubbornness, purposeless wandering, frivolous laughter, and heedlessness of one's sins reflect a comprehensive prophetic ethic of inner and outer discipline.

en.bilal-muhammad: `Ali b. Ahmad b. `Abdullah b. Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from his grandfather Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah from Muhammad b. `Ali al-Kufi from Abi `Abdillah al-Khayyat from `Abdullah b. al-Qasim from `Abdullah b. Sinan from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as).

He said: Among that which Allah revealed to Musa b. `Imran (as) is: Be [like] a worn-out robe, pure of heart, reclusive in your house, and a lantern in the night, and you will be known to the people of heaven and hidden from the people of Earth.
O Musa! Beware of being insistent, and do not be of those who walk without purpose, and do not laugh without astonishment. Weep over your mistakes, O son of `Imran.
